part.name: l_corridor_course
part.description: L-shaped corridor course for an Isaac Sim scene: a thin L floor slab with vertical side walls along the inner and outer edges of the L, open at both ends. Built from origin-anchored rectangles only (v1 runner). Not modeled: end caps, ramps, surface texture, the wall-panel finish detail from the reference photos.

reference.origin_definition: O = outer (convex) corner of the L corridor at the underside of the floor slab. +X runs along side B, +Y runs along side A, +Z is up. The floor slab occupies Z 0..floor_thickness across the whole L footprint. Side walls occupy Z 0..wall_height along the outer edges (X=0 for leg A, Y=0 for leg B) and along the inner edges (offset by lane_width+wall_thickness). The lane is open at both far ends.

measurements.name: seg_a_length
measurements.measurement_instruction: Overall length of the L along side A: from the outer corner O to the open end of leg A, measured along the outer edge. One quantity only. Must be greater than lane_width + 2*wall_thickness.

measurements.name: seg_b_length
measurements.measurement_instruction: Overall length of the L along side B: from the outer corner O to the open end of leg B, measured along the outer edge. One quantity only. Must be greater than lane_width + 2*wall_thickness.

measurements.name: lane_width
measurements.measurement_instruction: Clear drivable width of the corridor between the inner face of the outer wall and the inner wall. Same for both legs. One quantity only.

measurements.name: wall_thickness
measurements.measurement_instruction: Thickness of a side wall, measured horizontally perpendicular to its run. Same value used for the outer wall and the inner wall. One quantity only.

measurements.name: wall_height
measurements.measurement_instruction: Overall height of a side wall measured from the ground (Z=0) to its top. The barrier height standing above the lane surface is wall_height minus floor_thickness. One quantity only.

measurements.name: floor_thickness
measurements.measurement_instruction: Thickness of the L floor slab (Z). One quantity only. Must be less than wall_height.

constraints.note: Leg A and leg B of the corridor meet at 90 degrees at the outer corner O.
Valid L requires strip_width (= lane_width + 2*wall_thickness) < seg_a_length AND < seg_b_length; also floor_thickness < wall_height.

metadata.notes: Course geometry for Isaac Sim. Walls on inner + outer edges only; lane open at both ends. No end walls, ramps, fillets or surface detail in this version.
